title: Independent Restricted Single-Level Linear Drainage Qualification
independent_source_reduction: legacy effective drain head is max(resolved prescribed drain level, zbotdr)
with SWNRSRF=0 the non-interflow drainage branch is q=diffl/drares when diffl>=0
with SWALLO=3 the negative-diffl infiltration branch is forced to q=0
therefore the restricted physical law is q=max(0,(gwl-effective_drain_head)/drares)

qualification_claims.flux_equivalence: candidate must reproduce the restricted legacy law over normalized finite positive-resistance domain
qualification_claims.effective_drain_head_abstraction: candidate control.drain_head is qualified only as the already-resolved effective drain head, not as OWLTAB parsing/interpolation
qualification_claims.sensitivity: stable active branch dq/dgwl=1/R; stable inactive branch dq/dgwl=0; activation point is explicitly nondifferentiable
qualification_claims.state: candidate is stateless and must not mutate committed state
qualification_claims.mass: returned soil_to_drain_rate is one authoritative physical transfer; runtime booking is not qualified here
qualification_claims.time: instantaneous law has no fundamental day/calendar assumption; resolution of time-varying drain head is external
qualification_claims.solver: no fully implicit trial-state drainage or solver Jacobian assembly is qualified

independence_rules: Do not use F-PM08A test fixtures or F-PM08A expected outputs as oracle.
Read the exact candidate source from the frozen F-PM08A closeout and bind its blob SHA.
Construct independent randomized and boundary cases from the source-reduced legacy law.
Qualification branch must contain no src/ or reference/ delta relative to clean base.
